# Azimlib visual identity

The wordmark and 2048-pixel globe are the preferred assets for project
presentations. The 110-pixel and 32-pixel icons have thicker grids and arrows
for small displays; they are distinct compositions, not simple reductions.

| Asset | Intended use |
| --- | --- |
| [Wordmark](azimlib-wordmark.png) | README and horizontal presentations |
| [2048-pixel globe](azimlib-logo-2048.png) | Large presentations and artwork |
| [110-pixel icon](azimlib-logo-110.png) | Compact project cards |
| [32-pixel icon](azimlib-logo-32.png) | Small icons |

All PNGs retain their original transparent backgrounds. The source images are
preserved byte for byte, with sizes and hashes in [the manifest](manifest.json).
Original visual compositions: Copyright (c) 2026 Kernerian, BSD-3-Clause.
The globe geometry uses Natural Earth public-domain data, rendered by Azimlib.
The underlying data remains governed by its own terms; see
[third-party notices](../../../THIRD_PARTY_LICENSES.md).
No Matplotlib logo, icon, artwork or implementation is included.

## Wordmark typography

The lettering uses **Carlito Bold Italic**, designed by Łukasz Dziedzic,
under the **SIL Open Font License 1.1**. [Upstream](https://github.com/googlefonts/carlito),
[license reference](https://github.com/google/fonts/blob/main/ofl/carlito/OFL.txt),
[official artwork FAQ](https://openfontlicense.org/ofl-faq/).
This is a voluntary acknowledgement of the design tool. These PNGs contain
rasterized lettering, not redistributed font software. The OFL does not require
artwork to use OFL or carry a credit; the original composition remains under
its stated BSD terms. No Carlito TTF/OTF/WOFF or font source is shipped.
The exact font binary/version used to make the wordmark was not retained;
this inventory does not invent a binary hash or transfer font copyright.
Any future distribution/embedding of the font must preserve its actual copyright,
OFL text and Reserved Font Name declaration. The current upstream reference
names the Carlito Project Authors and reserves the name Carlito.
